fluidair.gui.title: Fluid Air Configuration
fluidair.config.comment.ignoreFluidPhysi: Override all local-player fluid movement using the selected Movement model. Non-movement fluid effects remain unchanged. This changes client-side movement prediction only.
fluidair.config.comment.model: Air rules treat water, lava, and bubble columns as air. Water rules treat them as ordinary water, including swimming in lava while suppressing bubble-column lift and drag. This option only applies while Ignore fluid physics is enabled.
fluidair.config.comment.openConfigGui: Opens the Fluid Air configuration screen.
